summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 and nine-month 2026 earnings release and consolidated financial statements. The report cites record quarterly production of 95,557 GEO (+27% QoQ, +29% YoY), 253,131 GEO year-to-date, net revenue of $386.0 million, adjusted EBITDA of $236.9 million, and net debt to LTM adjusted EBITDA of 0.20x. Management reaffirms 2026 guidance of 340k-390k GEO and notes Era Dorada remains on time and on budget. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transactional terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated. Watch operational delivery versus guidance and project execution.
